macros.name: tllabelcventry
macros.doc: The \tllabelcventry macro is similar to \tlcventry, but it takes yet a third additional argument, which lets you set a label for the time line.

macros.name: tlmarkheightmo
macros.doc: You can set the height of the marks with \tlmarkheightmo (default = 0.2ex).

macros.name: tlmarkheightyr
macros.doc: You can set the height of the marks with \tlmarkheightyr (default = 0.4ex).

macros.name: tltext
macros.doc: You can set the sizes of both the start and end dates by calling the \tltext macro with a text size macro.

macros.name: tltextend
macros.doc: If you wish to set the size of the end date label, you can do so by using \tltextend, passing it a text size macro.

macros.name: tltextend
macros.doc: If you wish to set the size of the end date label, you can do so by using \tltextend, passing it a text size macro.

macros.name: tltextsingle
macros.doc: If you wish to set the size of single date labels, you can do so by using \tltextsingle, passing it a text size macro.

macros.name: tltextstart
macros.doc: If you wish to set the size of the start date label, you can do so by using \tltextstart, passing it a text size macro.

macros.name: tltextstart

macros.name: tlwidth
macros.doc: You can optionally set the width of the time line by calling \tlwidth with a dimension.
